SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Enable Voice Tags
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Allow inline ` backquote voice tags to change voices and sing. Normal backquotes will be treated as code.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Override Default Pitch
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Enable to manually set the base pitch (like NVDA). Disable to use each voice's natural pitch.

SeekBarPreference.android:title: Default Pitch
SeekBarPreference.android:summary: Adjust the absolute base pitch of the Eloquence voice

SeekBarPreference.android:title: Speech Rate Multiplier
SeekBarPreference.android:summary: Multiply the speech rate requested by the system

ListPreference.android:title: Voice Persona
ListPreference.android:summary: Select the Eloquence voice (e.g., Reed, Shelly)

ListPreference.android:title: Force Language
ListPreference.android:summary: Override the system language (default is System)

ListPreference.android:title: Sample Rate
ListPreference.android:summary: Upsample the 11025 Hz engine output for higher quality playback

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Ignore SSML Tags
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Strip XML/SSML tags from the text before speaking
